notes.title: 1.5.3.10 Accumulated minor version updates
notes.content:
Optimized the display of the Dock
The "Open with" option has been added
Newly added automatic backup of layout
Fixed the issue where changes made to images were not saved in a timely manner
Fixed the issue of the application crashing when dragging and dropping files into it
Fixed the issue where some auto-start settings were ineffective (please cancel the settings and reset them)
Fixed the issue where native mode was unavailable

notes.title: 1.5.3.5 Accumulated updates of small versions
notes.content:
[h2]For Beginners[/h2]
The novice guide has been further optimized
Added more "Quick Settings" options

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
One-click setting for auto-start and offline start
Optimize the appearance of the Dock

[h2]Fix[/h2]
Fixed the issue of black screen in some cases
Fixed the issue of some windows being black
Fixed the issue of drag delay for some Windows 10 users
Fixed the issue where some applications in traditional mode could not respond to dragging
Fixed some permission issues
Fixed the issue where icons in the Dock and grid disappear in some cases

notes.title: 1.5.3.0 Medium update
notes.content: [p]1.5.3.0 Update[/p][p]User-friendly update for beginners[/p][p]● Added a beginner's guide (will be continuously updated)[/p][p]● Added quick settings, allowing one-click configuration for most commonly used settings, accompanied by descriptions and examples[/p][p]● Added troubleshooting and contact us sections, allowing for quick resolution of some issues[/p][p]Feature update[/p][p]● Add and adopt the Windows drag-and-drop logic by default, ensuring consistency with native Windows operation logic in most scenarios[/p][p]● Added "Only use home screen" mode, where the software only covers the home screen[/p][p]● Functions such as double-click to hide and page turning are optional and disabled by default to prevent accidental touches[/p][p]● More user-friendly editing mode options[/p][p]● No more cumbersome initialization process[/p][p]Fixing[/p][p]● Fixed the issue of black screen in some scenarios[/p][p]● Fixed the file issue when modifying the desktop to the root directory of the disk (users affected by this issue should reset and recover)[/p][p]● Fixed the issue where it was not possible to drag and drop to open in folders or files[/p][p]● Fixed the issue of crashing in some situations[/p][p]● Fixed the issue where GIFs could not be dragged[/p][p]● Fixed the issue where images could not be saved after being set[/p][p]● Fixed the issue where the settings could not be saved after adding a component[/p][p]● Fixed the issue of preventing shutdown in some situations[/p]

notes.title: Sapphire Steam Version Update
notes.content: [p]Supports multiple devices and can run independently of Steam. Please manually create a desktop shortcut for the main software program Sapphire.exe. In rare cases, it may be necessary to launch it from Steam[/p][p]The Creative Workshop will provide support in the future[/p][p]Administrator privileges[/p][p]The software no longer runs with administrator privileges by default[/p][p]To use high-priority automatic startup, you need to set it with administrator privileges (right-click on the program, run as an administrator, and set it in the settings box)[/p][p]If high-priority automatic startup is not required, it can be set through conventional means[/p][p]Custom widgets are now available[/p][p]Support for QML components (a scripting language similar to JavaScript)[/p][p]Using GPU graphics, various advanced animations, visual effects, and interactions can be defined[/p][p]Support html/webpage as a component[/p][p]Using browser engine/GPU for drawing consumes a lot of memory and performance, please use with caution![/p][p]You can write your own widgets or directly use widgets written by others[/p][p]The widget instance and tutorial will be launched online as soon as possible[/p][p]Windows SMTC support[/p][p]Fully compatible with Windows SMTC functionality[/p][p]Used in conjunction with the widget, it serves as a desktop player[/p][p]Folder interaction optimization[/p][p]Display up to 50 files[/p][p]Cancel recursive expansion[/p][p]No longer load images within folders (can be turned on in the settings panel)[/p][p]This update is a stability update, optimizing 90% of the issues related to lag and crashes. It will continue to restore and add features[/p][p]Multi-screen display optimization[/p][p]System UI styling and optimization[/p][p]The new appearance includes:[/p][p]Settings Panel[/p][p]context menu[/p][p]prompt box[/p][p]Notice[/p][p]label[/p][p]Windows 11 uses acrylic material[/p][p]Windows 10 uses transparent blur material[/p][p]Various parameters can be set in the "Appearance" interface[/p][p]Right-click menu now:[/p][p]Set attributes in batch[/p][p]Display the number of pasted files in advance[/p][p]The "New" menu is more comprehensive[/p][p]Shortcut keys (customization will be supported in the future)[/p][p]Show/Hide software (switch to native desktop): alt+s[/p][p]Open the settings panel by pressing ctrl+,[/p][p]Support the option to restore all default icons with one click[/p][p]Parallax effect[/p][p]Desktop icons will generate corresponding offsets according to the movement of the mouse[/p][p]It can be opened and set up in the settings panel[/p][p]It may have an impact on performance, please use with caution[/p][p]Updated page turning animation, with smoother scrolling up and down animation[/p][p]repair[/p][p]Fix the issue of software crashing but the tray still exists[/p][p]The issue of software disappearing when launching software such as QQ Music (please try turning on "Deep Integration")[/p][p]Fixed some black screen issues[/p][p]The issue of files not being able to be dragged into folders[/p][p]Optimized the visual perception of position during dragging[/p][p]Fixed the issue where multiple pages may be displayed simultaneously[/p][p]Fixed the issue where the settings panel would follow the cursor after clicking a link in the settings panel[/p]
